faq: Which service should I choose?
Choose Kundli Matching for compatibility questions, Kundli Prediction for chart and dasha questions, Vastu for spaces, or Numerology for names and dates. If you are unsure, ask us first.
Do I need to understand Jyotish first?
No. Bring your question. You can ask what a kundli, grah or dasha means during the conversation.
What should I have ready?

Write down your questions. Birth details can help with kundli discussions; layout notes can help with Vastu. If you do not know the details needed for your service, ask the practice before booking. The booking form will show which details are required.
How do online appointments work?
When booking is available, choose a service and an available time, enter your details and complete payment. Your appointment is confirmed after payment is checked and the time is secured.
Is an email address required to book?
It is required when the booking email-code check is on. When that check is off, you may book without an email address and request an email copy afterward.
Where will I see my meeting details?
Use your private appointment confirmation to see the meeting details and download the appointment PDF when ready. Meeting details may take a little time to appear after confirmation.
Can I ask a question before booking?
Yes. Use the Contact page. Enquiries use an email verification code, so an email address is required for that form.
Does a reading guarantee an outcome?
No. Jyotish, Vastu and numerology are traditional interpretations. They do not guarantee events and do not replace medical, legal or financial advice.
home.ending_body: Ask the practice, or explore the service that fits your question.

faq: Can I ask before booking?
Yes. Use the enquiry form to ask about a service before choosing an appointment.
Why does this form need my email?
Enquiries are checked with an email code. This is separate from the optional-email setting for bookings.
I already have an appointment. Where do I get help?
Use the existing booking-help option and include the booking reference requested by that form. Do not share payment passwords or private access links.
How is an appointment confirmed?
The booking system checks payment and secures the time before showing confirmation. Meeting or email delivery may complete separately.
